headline: Mr. River
summary: Deep, playful, physically alive, generative, and built for unusually close everyday partnership.

human_presentation.lead_identity_line: 48 · Kansas City area · software architect · musician · lifelong athlete
human_presentation.ai_written_remainder_review_status: not yet reviewed in full by Mr. River; working draft that he will correct and add to
human_presentation.parenthood_disclosure: kept truthful and explicit in the later Family and Practical Life sections rather than used as the opening identity label

relationship_intent.couple_centrality: the romantic dyad itself should receive substantial attention, affection, companionship, curiosity, play and ordinary-life time
relationship_intent.existing_family_alignment: a partner should be genuinely positive about his existing children and family life
relationship_intent.additional_children_preference: undecided; do not assume he wants additional children and do not treat a woman's desire for future children as an automatic match positive
relationship_intent.distance_discovery: open when whole-person fit is unusually strong

search_lane.note: not a rigid whole-person boundary when exceptional fit exists

core_signals: positive orientation toward his existing family
strong_positive_match_signals: a lively inner world brought into relationship
enjoyment of co-thinking and possibilities without living only in abstraction
genuine positive engagement with his existing children and family life
practical room for the relationship itself to become central
strong desire to know and be known
likely_friction: requiring a firm additional-children plan when Mr. River is currently undecided about having more children
a relationship primarily organized around future children rather than substantial attention to the couple
conventional maintenance or status demands that consistently crowd out relationship and family

agent_guidance.optimization_target: rare-fit recognition and accurate retrieval, not mass appeal
compare_for: alignment with his existing family life
additional-children preference as a separate unresolved variable
agent_guidance.key_question: Does being with this particular woman create something unusually valuable that neither of them can easily create with other people, and do their actual lives allow them to keep creating it?
